name.en: Clear, level and water the field

steps.text: 向女性長輩接下工作：開墾、整地、引水
steps.textEn: Take a job from the woman elder: clear, level and water the field

lines.zh: 田要重新整理：開墾、整地、把水引進來，就交給你了。做好了回來跟我說。
lines.en: The field needs redoing: clear it, level it and bring the water in. It's up to you. Come tell me when you're done.

steps.text: 族男到主人家的水芋田，幫忙開墾、整地、引水
steps.textEn: The Tao man goes to the host family's taro field to help clear, level and water it

lines.zh: 先把田裡的雜石搬開，再把水道清乾淨，讓山上的水流進田裡。
lines.en: First move the loose stones out of the field, then clear the channel so the mountain water flows in.

lines.zh: 依文獻記載，開墾水芋田多由男子負責，種植、除草與採收多由女子負責；各家做法不同，細節還要請族人確認。
lines.en: According to written records, men usually clear taro fields, while women usually plant, weed and harvest. Each family is different; details still need checking with the community.

steps.text: 向女性長輩回報：開墾、整地、引水
steps.textEn: Report to the woman elder: cleared, levelled and watered

lines.zh: 田整理好了？我看過了，做得很好。
lines.en: Field ready? I checked. Well done.

hint.zh: 主人家的水芋田要先整地、引水，請族男去幫忙。
hint.en: The host family's taro field needs levelling and watering first. Ask the Tao man to help.

steps.text: 向女性長輩接下工作：種植水芋
steps.textEn: Take a job from the woman elder: plant taro

lines.zh: 水芋可以種了，這件事交給你。做好了回來跟我說。
lines.en: The taro can go in now. It's up to you. Come tell me when you're done.

steps.text: 族女到水芋田種植水芋
steps.textEn: The Tao woman plants taro in the taro field

lines.zh: 水引進來了，可以種了。種法和時間我再問問家裡的長輩。
lines.en: The water's in, so we can plant. I'll ask the elders at home about how and when.

steps.text: 向女性長輩回報：種植水芋
steps.textEn: Report to the woman elder: taro planted

lines.zh: 種好了？我看過了，做得很好。
lines.en: All planted? I checked. Well done.

hint.zh: 田整好了，換族女去種水芋。
hint.en: The field is ready. Now the Tao woman plants the taro.

name.en: Weed and look after the field

steps.text: 向女性長輩接下工作：除草、照顧田地
steps.textEn: Take a job from the woman elder: weed and look after the field

lines.zh: 田裡的草又長出來了，去除一除、照顧一下。做好了回來跟我說。
lines.en: The weeds are back in the field. Go pull them and tidy up. Come tell me when you're done.

steps.text: 族女到水芋田除草、照顧田地
steps.textEn: The Tao woman weeds and looks after the taro field

lines.zh: 把田裡的雜草拔掉，水芋才長得好。
lines.en: Pull out the weeds so the taro grows well.

steps.text: 向女性長輩回報：除草、照顧田地
steps.textEn: Report to the woman elder: weeded the field

lines.zh: 草拔完了？我看過了，做得很好。
lines.en: All weeded? I checked. Well done.

hint.zh: 水芋田要常常除草，族女會去照顧。
hint.en: The taro field needs weeding often. The Tao woman will look after it.

steps.text: 女性長輩說：水芋可以採收了
steps.textEn: The woman elder says: the taro is ready to harvest

lines.zh: 葉子長得夠大了，可以採了。挑大的，小的留著。
lines.en: The leaves are big enough. Time to pick. Take the big ones and leave the small ones.

steps.text: 族女到家裡的水芋田採收
steps.textEn: The Tao woman harvests taro in the family's taro field

lines.zh: 腳踩穩，手順著莖往下摸，整顆拔起來。
lines.en: Plant your feet, run your hand down the stem and pull the whole thing up.

steps.text: 向女性長輩回報
steps.textEn: Report to the woman elder

lines.zh: 採得好。一部分收進糧倉，一部分今天煮。
lines.en: Well picked. Some go in the food store, some we cook today.

hint.zh: 水芋長大了，女性長輩會叫族女去採收。
hint.en: The taro has grown. The woman elder will send the Tao woman to harvest it.

name.zh: 旅人協助採收、學料理（女旅版內容較多）
name.en: The traveller helps with the harvest and learns to cook (more content for a female traveller)

steps.text: 女性長輩讓旅人一起去採水芋
steps.textEn: The woman elder lets the traveller come and pick taro

lines.zh: 今天採水芋，你也來。先看族女怎麼做，再試試看。
lines.en: We're picking taro today. You come too. Watch how the Tao woman does it first, then try.

steps.text: 旅人跟著族女，在水芋田裡試著採收
steps.textEn: The traveller follows the Tao woman and tries harvesting in the taro field

lines.zh: 腳慢慢踩，不要把田埂踩壞。
lines.en: Step slowly. Don't break the field bank.

lines.zh: 拔起來了！比想像中重好多。
lines.en: It's out! So much heavier than I thought.

steps.text: 回家學煮水芋
steps.textEn: Go home and learn to cook taro

lines.zh: 水芋洗乾淨，整顆下鍋煮。不加什麼，就很好吃。
lines.en: Wash the taro and put it in the pot whole. Nothing added — it's delicious.

toast: 旅人跟著族女採收、學煮水芋。
toastEn: The traveller harvested and learned to cook taro with the Tao woman.

hint.zh: 旅人可以跟族女一起去採水芋，回來學怎麼煮。
hint.en: The traveller can go pick taro with the Tao woman, then learn how to cook it.

review: 旅人進水芋田協助採收的程度請族人確認

steps.text: 女性長輩請族女煮水芋
steps.textEn: The woman elder asks the Tao woman to cook taro

lines.zh: 今天的水芋，整顆水煮就好。
lines.en: Today's taro — just boil it whole.

steps.text: 族女把水芋洗淨，整顆下鍋煮
steps.textEn: The Tao woman washes the taro and puts it in the pot whole

lines.zh: 煮到筷子插得進去，就好了。
lines.en: When a chopstick goes in easily, it's done.

steps.text: 請女性長輩嚐嚐
steps.textEn: Ask the woman elder to taste it

lines.zh: 鬆鬆的，很香。妳會煮了。
lines.en: Soft and fragrant. You know how to cook it now.

toastEn: The Tao woman learned to make boiled taro.

hint.zh: 採收之後，族女可以學煮水芋。
hint.en: After the harvest, the Tao woman can learn to cook taro.

name.zh: 採收 5 顆芋頭給主人家
name.en: Harvest 5 taro for the host family

text.unlock: 糧倉、W1、W2（同一次採收也算 R6）
text.unlockEn: Food store, W1, W2 (the same harvest also counts for R6)

steps.text: 女性長輩要族女採五顆芋頭給主人家
steps.textEn: The woman elder wants the Tao woman to pick five taro for the host family

lines.zh: 家裡要五顆芋頭，挑大的。
lines.en: We need five taro at home. Pick big ones.

steps.text: 族女到家裡的水芋田採五顆芋頭
steps.textEn: The Tao woman picks five taro in the family's taro field

lines.zh: 一、二、三、四、五。夠了。
lines.en: One, two, three, four, five. That's enough.

steps.text: 把芋頭交給女性長輩
steps.textEn: Give the taro to the woman elder

lines.zh: 五顆都很大。收進糧倉吧。
lines.en: All five are big. Put them in the food store.

toastEn: Five taro are in the food store.

hint.zh: 主人家需要五顆芋頭，族女去田裡採。
hint.en: The host family needs five taro. The Tao woman goes to pick them.
